# S62A - Migration audit log

Runs after the `LOAD` stage and records, per case, whether it was migrated. Each run writes a new file to the audit folder of the S62A ADLS container; existing audit files are never changed.

Which cases count as migrated:
- `LOADED_CASES` given (list of case IDs read back from the database after `LOAD`): only cases found there are `MIGRATED`, any other case is `NOT_FOUND_IN_DATABASE` and the notebook fails after writing the log.
- `LOADED_CASES` not given: every case in `S62aCase.csv` (the file `LOAD` copies) is `MIGRATED`, relying on the pipeline only starting this notebook when `LOAD` succeeded.

# Parameters
STORAGE_ACCOUNT = None   # defaults to the S62A account for the detected environment
STORAGE_KEY     = None   # optional (linked service, secret name); default is the workspace managed identity

SCHEMA_DIR = "OUTPUT/SCHEMA/latest"   # the folder LOAD copies from
AUDIT_DIR  = "OUTPUT/AUDIT/MIGRATION"

LOADED_CASES    = None   # optional JSON list of case IDs (or {"id": ...}) read from S62aCase in the database after LOAD
MIGRATED_AT     = None   # optional UTC timestamp of the load, defaults to now
PIPELINE_RUN_ID = None   # optional, pass @pipeline().RunId

import re
from notebookutils import mssparkutils

ACCOUNTS = {
    "dev":  "pinssts62adevukseftlkl",
    "test": "pinssts62atestuksnkavj4",
    "prod": "pinssts62aproduksrz8i4g",
}

ws = mssparkutils.env.getWorkspaceName().lower()
m  = re.search(r"(?:^|[-_])(dev|test|prod)(?:[-_]|$)", ws)
if not m:
    raise ValueError(f"Can't detect env from workspace name '{ws}'")
ENV     = m.group(1)
ACCOUNT = STORAGE_ACCOUNT or ACCOUNTS[ENV]
ROOT    = f"abfss://s62a@{ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/PIPELINE"

if STORAGE_KEY:
    spark.conf.set(f"fs.azure.account.key.{ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net",
                   mssparkutils.credentials.getSecretWithLS(*STORAGE_KEY).strip())

print(f"ENV={ENV} | ROOT={ROOT}")

# Build the audit rows
import pandas as pd

at = pd.Timestamp(MIGRATED_AT) if MIGRATED_AT else pd.Timestamp.now(tz="UTC")
at = at.tz_localize("UTC") if at.tzinfo is None else at.tz_convert("UTC")
RUN_TS = at.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

ok = cases["id"].str.upper().isin(loaded) if loaded is not None else pd.Series(True, index=cases.index)
audit = pd.DataFrame({
    "caseId":              cases["id"],
    "caseReference":       cases["reference"],
    "historicalReference": cases["historicalReference"],
    "migrationStatus":     ok.map({True: "MIGRATED", False: "NOT_FOUND_IN_DATABASE"}),
    "migratedAt":          [at.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") if o else None for o in ok],
    "message":             [f"Case migrated successfully from Horizon and spreadsheet data on {at.strftime('%d/%m/%Y')}" if o
                            else "Case not found in the database after load, not migrated" for o in ok],
    "verifiedAgainst":     "database" if loaded is not None else "load_stage",
    "environment":         ENV,
    "pipelineRunId":       PIPELINE_RUN_ID,
})
missing = audit[audit.migrationStatus != "MIGRATED"]
print(audit.migrationStatus.value_counts().to_string())
print(audit.head(5).to_string(index=False))

# One new file per run, so repeated or parallel runs never overwrite each other
dest = f"{ROOT}/{AUDIT_DIR}/migration_audit_{RUN_TS}.csv"
mssparkutils.fs.put(dest, audit.to_csv(index=False), True)
print(f"Wrote {len(audit)} rows to {dest}")

if len(missing):
    raise Exception(f"{len(missing)} case(s) were not found in the database after LOAD: "
                    + ", ".join(missing.caseReference.fillna(missing.caseId).head(20)))
